newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Italian troops land at Albania airport.
newsitem.headline: Italian troops land at Albania airport.

text.p: The main landing force of a multinational security mission for Albania began arriving at Tirana's airport on Tuesday, witnesses said.

The first of six Italian military aircraft carrying some 150 Italian paratroopers landed at the airport at 6.45 a.m. (0445 GMT). Ships carrying more than 1,000 Italian, French and Spanish troops were nearing the western port of Durres.

Witnesses in Durres said the French transport ship Orage was near Durres. The ship had sailed from the Italian harbour of Brindisi with 450 French troops. Other ships with 200 Italian soldiers and 350 Spanish troops were expected in Durres later in the morning.
An advance unit of about 100 Italian troops arrived in Albania on Friday. The total force will number about 6,000 soldiers. Turkey, Romania, Greece, Austria and Denmark are contributing troops.

The eight-nation force has been tasked to safeguard the distribution of aid to the troubled Balkan state, which sank into near anarchy after fraudulent savings schemes collapsed early this year. Nearly 300 people have been killed in the violence.
The first major food aid shipment of more than 400 tonnes of wheat flour, beans and vegetable oil was expected in Durres on Tuesday.
